sections.title: What it is
sections.body: Matching Duality Dice create the best version of the result.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Use whenever the Hope and Fear dice match.

sections.title: Step by step
items: Use whenever the Hope and Fear dice match.
Treat it as a Critical Success: gain Hope, clear 1 Stress, and give a strong result.
Return to the fiction with the concrete result, cost, or benefit.
